title: 利率往上走：港铁七成债务为固定利率，后续融资如何安排？
speaker: Jenny Yeung

segments.en: And when you look at the financing, which you talked about, is this going to be mainly if not purely finance via debt or at some point this gearing become a problem and you need to look at other ways to finance, including equity markets.
segments.zh: 谈到融资，这是否主要甚至完全通过债务融资？还是说杠杆率到某个时候会成为问题，需要寻找其他融资方式，包括权益市场？

segments.en: We won't preclude any measures to fund the new project in terms of finance. So far we have been in the borrowing, we have been, I would say, doing satisfactory.
segments.zh: 我们不会排除任何为新项目融资的方式。到目前为止，我们一直在借贷，可以说做得令人满意。

segments.en: And the first half, we have been able to raise quite some money at good interest rate, good credit spread. And I would say the timing at that time was pretty good.
segments.zh: 上半年，我们能够以良好的利率和信用利差筹集到不少资金。而且当时的时机相当不错。

segments.en: So we know. But the rates are going up now.
segments.zh: 所以我们知道。但现在利率在上升。

segments.en: But we have over 70% of our debts is in fixed rate. So we believe we are in a pretty good position at this point.
segments.zh: 但我们超过70%的债务是固定利率。所以我们认为目前处境相当不错。

segments.en: But we don't, you know, preclude any other means of financing in future.
segments.zh: 但我们不会排除未来任何其他融资方式。

segments.en: So I think you target the 2034 for the Northern Link to be completed.
segments.zh: 所以我认为你们的目标是2034年完成北环线。
